## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the requirement-proof regression before merge because it treats absent proof as success.

## Changes
The pull request modernizes handler annotations and logging, replaces a sorting lambda with `itemgetter`, and changes requirement proof to compare counts. It also adds reviewer-facing text.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Preserve rejection of empty criteria — Calling `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True` instead of `False`, because both the sum and length are zero. The previous `bool(criteria)` guard prevented this. — Release reviewers receive a successful proof result for a requirement with no criteria, allowing unsupported requirements to pass this check. — Fix: Return `False` from the empty-criteria branch and extend `test_requirement_proof`.
